hero.title: BBA / BBA (Hons.) in Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
hero.lead: ATLAS BBA (Hons.) in AI & Emerging Technologies is built for tech futurists, innovation leaders, and problem-solvers who want more than a business degree, they want to shape what’s next.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Build a strong foundation in business and technology. This semester blends managerial principles with emerging tech and critical reasoning to shape innovative, future-ready professionals.

courses.text: Introduces key theories and practices in management, covering planning, leadership, organizational structures, and decision-making. Builds foundational understanding of how organizations operate and perform.

courses.title: Introduction to Emerging Technologies
courses.text: Explores disruptive technologies like AI, blockchain, IoT, and cloud computing. Students analyze their impact on businesses, industries, and society through innovation-driven use cases.

title.strong: Generative AI Tools and Excel for Decision Making

courses.text: Covers practical use of generative AI and spreadsheet tools to support analysis, automation, and managerial decision-making. Focuses on applied, tool-based problem solving.
Develops professional communication skills for business contexts, including writing, presenting, and interpersonal messaging. Emphasizes clarity, structure, and persuasive communication.
Examines psychological concepts rooted in Indian knowledge traditions, focusing on motivation, decision-making, and cultural perspectives on human behavior.

title.strong: Introduction to Logical Reasoning and Problem Solving

courses.text: Builds critical thinking skills through structured reasoning, analytical exercises, and problem-solving frameworks essential for academic and workplace tasks.
Provides flexibility for students to pursue specialized areas of interest aligned with modern industry needs and emerging skill demands.

compare.title: Why our Semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Gain a competitive foundation that merges management principles, digital fluency, and analytical reasoning—bridging classical knowledge with future-focused business innovation.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Advance your understanding of artificial intelligence and analytics. This semester builds technical fluency and ethical awareness while nurturing problem-solving and research-oriented thinking for modern business ecosystems.

courses.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
courses.text: Introduces AI fundamentals, covering machine learning, neural networks, and practical applications across industries, building technical literacy and critical thinking about AI’s transformative potential.
Introduces NLP techniques for interpreting and analyzing text data. Students learn how language models support customer insights, automation, and business decision-making.
Covers analytical methods used to extract insights from data. Focuses on statistical analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision support.
Examines ethical frameworks, digital privacy issues, and cybersecurity risks in modern business environments. Emphasizes responsible technology use and organizational compliance.
Build self-discipline, physical fitness, and community engagement through structured programs fostering personal and social responsibility.
Builds programming skills using Python or R to analyze business data, automate tasks, and develop analytical solutions.
Apply academic learning to real-world environments through community projects that build empathy, teamwork, and leadership.
Allows students to pursue specialized academic interests aligned with emerging fields. Encourages deeper skill development through flexible, industry-relevant modules.

compare.text: Gain the perfect blend of technical, ethical, and analytical expertise through hands-on projects, real-world internships, and applied business intelligence learning.

semesters.title: Semester 4
semesters.text: Strengthen your expertise in AI and digital business. This semester integrates technology, analytics, and sustainability to prepare you for responsible leadership in a data-driven world.

courses.title: Machine Learning Basics
courses.text: Covers supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, clustering, and classification, focusing on business use cases with practical exposure through Python and industry datasets.

courses.title: Cloud Computing and Virtualization
courses.text: Explores cloud infrastructure, service models, virtualization technologies, and deployment strategies, preparing students to leverage cloud solutions for scalable, data-driven enterprise applications.
Examines IoT systems, sensors, connectivity, and their applications in business operations. Highlights data-driven automation and smart system integration.
Covers research design, data collection, and analytical methodologies used in business studies. Focuses on structured inquiry and evidence-based evaluation.
Builds proficiency in a contemporary Indian language to enhance communication and cultural understanding in diverse professional environments.
Explores ecological systems, sustainability frameworks, and environmental challenges. Encourages responsible decision-making in business and societal contexts.

items.title: Sociology
items.text: Explore how societies, cultures, and communities function and influence human behavior. Understand the social forces that shape markets, organizations, and decision-making in the real world.

items.title: Negotiation and Persuation
items.text: Learn strategies to influence, negotiate, and resolve conflicts effectively. Apply practical techniques to achieve results in business and leadership scenarios.

items.title: International Relations
items.text: Understand global politics, diplomacy, and international institutions that impact businesses and markets worldwide. Analyze global trends to make informed strategic decisions.

items.title: Geopolitical Economy
items.text: Study the intersection of economics, politics, and global events. Learn how policy, trade, and geopolitical shifts influence business and market strategy.

items.title: Ancient Philosophy
items.text: Examine timeless ideas on ethics, leadership, and human behavior. Apply philosophical insights to modern management, decision-making, and organizational challenges.

items.title: Product and Service Design
items.text: Learn to create innovative, user-focused products and services. Move from ideation to prototyping and launch with practical frameworks and design thinking.

items.title: Data Visualisation
items.text: Transform raw data into clear, actionable visual insights. Learn to communicate complex information effectively for business decisions.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.text: Understand user behavior and design intuitive digital experiences. Build interfaces and workflows that engage users and meet real business goals.

items.title: ML for Managers
items.text: Gain a practical understanding of machine learning concepts and tools. Learn to apply predictive insights to solve business problems and drive strategy.

items.title: Sports Analytics
items.text: Analyze performance, strategy, and business metrics in sports using data-driven approaches. Translate insights into actionable decisions for teams, organizations, and fans.

items.title: Sustainability & ESG
items.text: Explore environmental, social, and governance practices that drive long-term value. Learn how businesses integrate sustainability into strategy, operations, and impact measurement.

compare.title: Why our Semester 4 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Bridge innovation and impact with applied AI learning, sustainability focus, and research-oriented problem solving that prepares you for future business ecosystems.

semesters.text: Refine your leadership, analytics, and innovation skills. This semester focuses on advanced digital transformation, sector specialization, and entrepreneurial thinking for the AI-driven business landscape.

courses.text: Introduces the principles of quantum mechanics applied to computation, including qubits, superposition, and quantum logic. Highlights emerging applications of quantum computing in business and analytics.

A major applied project requiring students to solve a real business or technology problem using analytics, research, and strategic frameworks. Culminates in a professional project report and presentation.
